lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a visible grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped notch or indentation is visible on the posterior (trailing) edge of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, elongated low-luminance silhouettes positioned ventrally to the main flank and pectoral fin.
